headline: Stagnation in Home Sales, Number of Rental Apartments Rises
summary: Izmir Real Estate Brokers Association President Serhat Gültekin said home sales declined across Türkiye while the number of rental apartments increased. He also commented on rental prices and sector problems.
why: Housing transactions and rents are key indicators of household demand and construction activity, shaping real estate lending and developer earnings.
